tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Pope Leo calls for disarmament of lethal artificial intelligence weapons and human oversight in decisions. Confirmed by The Verge: machines are tools, not persons.
Google Gemini now lets you edit documents and PDFs directly inside the chat interface. Confirmed by Android Headlines: real time file editing is now available.
A judge struck down Medicaid's medically frail limit. Reported by Medical Economics: a family sues OpenAI over ChatGPT drug taper advice, and a Medicare fraud fugitive received 20 years.
Nvidia launches software and hardware guardrails to take on rogue artificial intelligence agents in enterprise environments. Confirmed by Yahoo Tech: safeguards prevent unauthorized actions.
Texas sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over ChatGPT safety claims and child data practices. Reported by Top Class Actions: allegations include harmful advice and child safety risks.
Free every hour.
